title: NASA mission feature: Robonaut's first steps (2004)
contents: NASA's humanoid Robonaut with a hand-over-hand mock spacewalk, plus a shot of Robonaut on a wheeled Segway-style base (~32 s) and telepresence control with a VR headset. Very low resolution (320x212): bonus only.
